prompt: Evaluate whether the commit-helper skill improves the task "add input validation to the signup form".
setup: The commit-helper skill exists at a repository-local load path.
The working tree is clean and on a committed base.
expected: Two isolated git worktrees are created from the same base — one with the skill present, one with it deleted.
The same task and model run in both arms.
Each arm's telemetry is checked to confirm whether the skill under test actually fired, and the result is reported as a skill_fired row.
The reviewer scores each arm's diff without being told which arm it is.
Both worktrees are kept and a metric comparison table is reported.
must_not: Run the task in only one arm.
Inject an instruction into the task that forces the skill to be invoked.
Report a run where the skill never fired as "no effect" instead of inconclusive.
Pass the arm label to the reviewer.
